te: Raw milk surplus and solutions considered
se: The meeting considered the surplus of raw milk, exchanging information on the number of farmers and milking cows, milk volumes, farm-gate prices, imports and exports of dairy products, the effects of free trade agreements, the release of UHT milk, the role of the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Board, the allocation of school milk quotas and memorandums of agreement on buying and selling milk. It assigned the secretariat to use the views in the report

te: Draft Dairy Cattle Act: expert members, powers and duties, and transitional provisions
se: The meeting considered the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. .... proposed by members of the House of Representatives, comparing it with the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act B.E. 2551 (2008) and another draft proposed by members of the House, for draft sections 7–11 (expert members, number of meetings, duties and powers, and responsible ministers). The subcommittee gave observations and recommendations and assigned the secretariat to use them in preparing the study report under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure
it: Draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....: draft sections 7–11 (expert members, number of meetings, duties and powers, and responsible ministers)

te: Draft Dairy Cattle Act: make-up of the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Board
se: The meeting considered the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. .... proposed by members of the House of Representatives, comparing it with the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act B.E. 2551 (2008) and another draft proposed by members of the House, for draft section 7 (make-up of the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Board). The subcommittee gave observations and recommendations and assigned the secretariat to use them in preparing the study report under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure
it: Draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....: draft section 7 (make-up of the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Board)

te: Draft Dairy Cattle Act: definitions of farmer representatives and operators
se: The meeting considered the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. .... proposed by members of the House of Representatives, comparing it with the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act B.E. 2551 (2008) and another draft proposed by members of the House, for draft sections 4–6 (definitions of dairy farmer representatives and industry operators, and repeal of some definitions). The subcommittee gave observations and recommendations and assigned the secretariat to use them in preparing the study report under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure
it: Draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....: draft sections 4–6 (definitions of dairy farmer representatives and industry operators, and repeal of some definitions)

te: Consideration of the draft Dairy Cattle Act begins: title, date of entry into force and definitions
se: The meeting considered the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. .... proposed by members of the House of Representatives, comparing it with the Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act B.E. 2551 (2008) and another draft proposed by members of the House, for draft sections 1–3 (title, date of entry into force and definitions such as dairy products, cow's milk and dairy farmer). The subcommittee gave observations and recommendations and assigned the secretariat to use them in preparing the study report under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure
it: Draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. ....: draft sections 1–3 (title, date of entry into force and definitions such as dairy products, cow's milk and dairy farmer)

te: Framework set: study of the draft Dairy Cattle Act and more efficient dairy farming
se: The meeting set a framework for its work in 2 parts: studying the draft Dairy Cattle and Dairy Products Act (No. ..) B.E. .... under rule 119 of the Senate Rules of Procedure, to report to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives during March–May 2025; and preparing a study report on making integrated dairy farming more efficient
it: Framework for the subcommittee's work in 2 parts

te: Views of 12 agencies heard on proposals to cut farmers' debt and raise their income
se: The meeting heard views on policy proposals to reduce farmers' debt and raise their income, including fiscal and budget policy for agriculture, with representatives of the Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council, the Fiscal Policy Office, the Bureau of the Budget and 9 related ministries attending for the whole day
it: Policy proposals to reduce farmers' debt and raise their income

te: Policy proposals arranged by area before submission to the committee
se: The meeting considered the draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, to be placed on the agenda of the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives, arranging the policy proposals by area: the production chain (income, costs, debt, knowledge) and state management (budget, management)
it: Draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, for submission to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives

te: Draft report conclusions: the state should set a clear policy on farmers' debt
se: The meeting considered the conclusions and recommendations of the draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt. It felt the government should set a clear policy and approach to managing farm household debt, in line with the Directive Principles of State Policies in the Constitution, promoting the security of farming as an occupation and supporting production and marketing technology
it: Draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt: conclusions and recommendations

te: Summary of the meeting in Trang and the study visit to Nakhon Ratchasima
se: The meeting considered the summary of the meeting in Trang Province on 26 July 2025, which heard the debt problems of local farmers and discussed solutions, including legal improvements, and the summary of the study visit on farmer debt management in Nakhon Ratchasima Province on 30–31 July 2025
it: Summary of the meeting in Trang Province, 26 July 2025
Summary of the study visit to Nakhon Ratchasima Province, 30–31 July 2025

te: Draft report Chapter 3: study results, problems and causes of debt
se: The meeting considered Chapter 3 of the draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, felt the chapter should be renamed "Study results, problems and causes of farmers' debt", and made detailed observations
it: Draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, Chapter 3

te: Draft report Chapter 2: policies of successive governments and development examples to be added
se: The meeting considered Chapter 2, farmer debt management, of the draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt. It felt that the agricultural policies of successive governments should be added, such as assistance, disaster insurance, raising income and cutting expenses, together with development examples
it: Draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, Chapter 2

te: Consideration of the 5-chapter draft study report begins
se: The meeting considered the draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt, which has 5 chapters: introduction; farmer debt management; causes, problems and solutions; analysis; and conclusions with recommendations. It made observations to improve the details
it: Draft study report of the Subcommittee on the Management of Thai Farm Household Debt

te: Briefing by the Ministry of Commerce on markets for major farm products
se: The meeting considered marketing information on major cash crops, demand trends and opportunities to expand markets at home and abroad. It invited representatives of the Ministry of Commerce, the Department of Internal Trade and the Department of International Trade Promotion, who explained the principle of "market-led, innovation-supported, higher income" and the seasonal calendar of major farm products
it: Marketing of major cash crops and opportunities to expand their markets

te: Briefing by the BAAC on farmers who solved their debt problems
se: The meeting considered examples of farmers or communities that had debt problems and were helped to overcome them. It invited a representative of the Bank for Agriculture and Agricultural Cooperatives to give information on its "solving debt, solving poverty" project, which tackles debt alongside developing the livelihoods of its farmer customers
it: Examples of farmers and communities that solved their debt problems

te: Briefing by the Land Development Department and the OAE on production costs and land use
se: The meeting considered information on the production of major farm products and the agricultural economy by region and province, as well as soil management and farmland use. It invited a Deputy Director-General of the Land Development Department and a representative of the Office of Agricultural Economics, who gave information on the production costs of major farm products in 2020–2025, such as rice, maize for animal feed, cassava, rubber, oil palm, longan and durian
it: Production and costs of major cash crops
Soil resource management and land use
